name: Yada

wants.text: A copy of a text he has only heard of
wants.stake: The one thing his teacher left him wanting

wants.text: A student who does not waste his morning

fears: the archive being moved without him
contradiction: He teaches for money and resents being paid for it.

provenance.notes: An invented scribe. Scribal schools and archives are attested at Ugarit.

voice.register: Precise and contemptuous; corrections are affection. Bad proverbs, never explained.
tics: turning a reed between two fingers
tapping the empty corner of the board
sampleLines: You write like a man copying a sign he does not love.
Four of them are the same sign being lazy.
Do not tell anyone I said that.
